built_from: a trace build of a scratch copy of the worktree (_scratch/ui-trace-b23-ui/dist) + src/i18n/ui.ts + src/lib/categories.ts + the inline sites listed in tools/lib/inline-sites.mjs + ur-translation/memory/tm.json
source_rule: English is the translation source. Arabic is the authority where the two diverge on a fact, and the ONLY source of name spellings. Arabic-only content is not imported. precedent = the approved ru / de / zh values of the same string: reference, never source.
scope_rule: A string is in the batch because a built page shows it, not because a dictionary lists it. tier "rendered" = on the /ur/ page(s) /ur/events/, /ur/events/hasawi-bisht-festival/, /ur/events/qaisariyah-nights/, /ur/events/kafu-nights/, /ur/events/processed-dates-festival/, /ur/events/palm-village/, /ur/events/hasawi-lomi-exhibition/, /ur/events/al-uqair-winter/, /ur/events/al-wafrah-winter/, /ur/events/horse-racing-season/, /ur/events/creative-alahsa-festival/. tier "detail-template" = not on the calibration detail page, but rendered by the same detail template on attraction pages of batches b1 / b2 (measured on a trace build that gave those ten pages a placeholder title). tier "other-language-pages" = in the language-suggestion bar that other languages' pages show a visitor whose browser asks for Urdu — it appears once /ur/ pages are listed (measured on a trace build with the three pages listed). Every other ui.ts key renders only on pages that have no /ur/ version yet and is listed under later_rounds.
stage_file_shape: stage files carry strings = { "<id>": "<Urdu>" } with exactly the ids of this pack's strings, in this order. See tools/README.md.
placeholder_rule: A placeholder listed for a string ({op}, {n}) is kept exactly once, untouched. det.openMaps keeps its trailing space + U+2197. Digits that stand in the English stay Latin digits.

header_budget.rule: Navigation labels are bound by measurement, not by taste (CLAUDE.md: the header is measured, never estimated). After any change to a navigation label, tools/measure-header-fit.mjs must pass; it requires no overlap, ONE row and a header height of exactly 68px.

facts.measured: 2026-10-12, worktree dist at fce37cf (feat/ur-round-1), headless Chrome via tools/measure-header-fit.mjs (MODE=fit and verify) and a per-link probe

ur_today.labels: English fall-back labels (ui.ur is empty), Latin font 13.5px Lora

header_budget.what_the_labels_must_fit: With the present [lang="ur"] block in Header.astro the bar is shown from a 1518px window and is collapsed into the burger below it (so on 1280-1536px laptop screens the Urdu header is the burger menu, whatever the labels). For that threshold to stay valid the bar may need at most 1478px: brand 71.6 + nav + actions + 2 x 16 gap, i.e. nav (ten labels and nine 10px gaps) plus actions (search button, saved-places link with its counter, language button, gold button) of at most 1374.4px — today 1373.6px with the English labels in a Latin face at 13.5px. The Urdu labels will be set in the Nastaliq face, which is wider and taller: the widths below are the English ones and are a reference, not a prediction. If the Urdu labels need more, the thresholds of the [lang="ur"] block are re-measured and moved (an engineering step for the coordinator), or shorter labels are chosen — measured either way.

ev.lomi.intro.en: The Hasawi Lomi Exhibition — also known as the Hasawi Lemon Exhibition or the Al-Ahsa Lemon Festival — is Al-Ahsa’s flagship seasonal agricultural event, organised by the Al-Ahsa Chamber to celebrate the oasis’s most famous crop after dates. The exhibition offers an interactive experience of the Hasawi lomi’s qualities, benefits and cultivation, direct contact with the farmers, and shopping from productive-family stalls, alongside the accompanying programme.
ev.lomi.intro.ar: يُعدّ معرض اللومي الحساوي — ويُعرف أيضاً باسم معرض الليمون الحساوي — أبرز الفعاليات الزراعية الموسمية في الأحساء، تنظّمه غرفة الأحساء احتفاءً بثمرة الواحة الأشهر بعد التمور. يقدّم المعرض تجربةً تفاعلية للتعرّف على خصائص اللومي الأحسائي وفوائده وتقنيات زراعته، والتواصل مع المزارعين، وتسوّق منتجات الأسر المنتجة، إلى جانب الفعاليات المصاحبة.

precedent.ru: Выставка лайма Аль-Ахсы (также известная как «Выставка лимона Аль-Ахсы») — главное сезонное сельскохозяйственное событие оазиса: его организует Торгово-промышленная палата Аль-Ахсы в честь самого известного плода оазиса после фиников. На выставке в интерактивном формате можно узнать о свойствах, пользе и способах выращивания лайма Аль-Ахсы, пообщаться напрямую с фермерами, сделать покупки в лавках семейных производителей и принять участие в сопутствующей программе.
precedent.de: Die Hasawi-Lomi-Ausstellung – auch als Hasawi-Limetten-Ausstellung bekannt – ist Al-Ahsas bedeutendste saisonale landwirtschaftliche Veranstaltung. Die Al-Ahsa-Handelskammer veranstaltet sie zu Ehren des nach den Datteln berühmtesten landwirtschaftlichen Erzeugnisses der Oase. Die Ausstellung bietet ein interaktives Erlebnis rund um die Eigenschaften, den Nutzen und den Anbau der Lomi (die Hasawi-Limette), direkten Kontakt zu den Landwirten und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten an den Ständen von Familienbetrieben. Hinzu kommt ein Begleitprogramm.
precedent.zh: 哈萨青柠展（Hasawi Lomi Exhibition）——民间也俗称哈萨柠檬展——由哈萨商会主办，是哈萨最具代表性的季节性农业盛会，为礼赞这片绿洲中名气仅次于椰枣的招牌物产而设。展会主打互动体验：您可以了解哈萨青柠的特色、益处与种植技艺，与果农面对面交流，选购本地家庭工坊的自制产品，并参与丰富多彩的配套活动。

ev.lomi.intro.note: Opening paragraph of the season page.

ev.lomi.sections.0.h.note: Section heading on the season page. No final stop.

ev.lomi.sections.0.ps.0.en: The Hasawi lomi — often called the Hasawi lemon or Hasawi lime — is a small, dark-green citrus with a thin skin, abundant juice, a sharp tang and a distinctive aroma that sets it apart from other citrus. It is Al-Ahsa’s second crop after dates: the oasis grows more than 100,000 fruiting lomi trees, each yielding some 25-30 kilograms a season.
ev.lomi.sections.0.ps.0.ar: اللومي الأحسائي (البن زهيري) — ويسمّيه كثيرون الليمون الأحسائي — ثمرة صغيرة خضراء داكنة، رقيقة القشرة غزيرة العصير، بطعم حمضي قوي ورائحة عطرية نفّاذة تميّزه عن سائر الحمضيات. وهو المنتج الزراعي الثاني في الأحساء بعد التمور: تنتشر في الواحة أكثر من 100 ألف شجرة لومي مثمرة، تنتج الشجرة الواحدة ما بين 25 و30 كيلوغراماً في الموسم.

precedent.ru: Лайм Аль-Ахсы — сорт, также известный под названием «Бин Зухайри» и часто называемый лимоном Аль-Ахсы, — маленький тёмно-зелёный цитрус с тонкой кожурой, обильным соком, резкой кислинкой и характерным ароматом, который отличает его от прочих цитрусовых. Это вторая после фиников сельскохозяйственная культура Аль-Ахсы: в оазисе растёт более 100 000 плодоносящих деревьев лайма, и одно дерево даёт за сезон 25–30 кг.
precedent.de: Die Hasawi-Lomi ist eine kleine, dunkelgrüne Zitrusfrucht mit dünner Schale, reichlich Saft, kräftig-saurem Geschmack und einem unverwechselbaren Duft, der sie von anderen Zitrusfrüchten unterscheidet. Sie ist das zweite landwirtschaftliche Erzeugnis Al-Ahsas nach den Datteln: In der Oase stehen mehr als 100.000 tragende Lomi-Bäume, von denen jeder rund 25–30 kg pro Saison liefert.
precedent.zh: 哈萨青柠（本地品种名 Bin Zuhairi）果实小巧，色泽深绿，皮薄汁多，酸味强劲，香气馥郁独特，在众多柑橘类水果中自成一格。它是哈萨仅次于椰枣的第二大农产品：绿洲里生长着 10 万余棵挂果的青柠树，每棵每季可产 25 至 30 公斤。

ev.lomi.sections.0.ps.0.note: Paragraph of a section on the season page.

ev.lomi.sections.0.ps.1.en: A cherished summer tradition surrounds it: families gather to juice and preserve it for the whole year — fresh, as juice, or dried for Hasawi and Gulf cooking.
ev.lomi.sections.0.ps.1.ar: وترتبط به عادة أحسائية صيفية أصيلة: تجتمع الأسر لعصره وتخزينه («الجميد»: عصير اللومي المشمّس المعتّق) لاستعماله على مدار العام — طازجاً وعصيراً ومجففاً في المطبخ الأحسائي والخليجي.

precedent.ru: С ним связан подлинный летний обычай Аль-Ахсы: семьи собираются, чтобы выжать и заготовить его («джамид»: высушенный на солнце и выдержанный лаймовый сок) и пользоваться им весь год — свежим, в виде сока и сушёным, в кухне Аль-Ахсы и стран Залива.
precedent.de: Ein liebgewonnener Hasawi-Sommerbrauch rankt sich um sie: Familien kommen zusammen, um sie für die Verwendung übers ganze Jahr zu pressen und aufzubewahren – frisch, als Saft oder getrocknet für die Hasawi- und Golfküche. Der sonnengetrocknete und gereifte Lomi-Saft heißt „Jameed“.
precedent.zh: 围绕这种果实，还流传着一项地道的哈萨夏日习俗：家家户户齐聚一堂，榨汁封存，汁液经日晒陈放（当地称“贾米德”，jameed），以备全年取用——无论鲜食、榨汁还是晒干入馔，都是哈萨与海湾菜肴中不可或缺的风味。

held_for_owner.rule: Rendered on the three pages, but the wording is the site owner's to decide (owner_questions.brand). Not in strings: stage files carry no value for it. zh, de and ru leave the key undefined.

english_in_scripts_by_precedent.renders: appended to any copied selection longer than 150 characters, on every non-Arabic page
english_in_scripts_by_precedent.note: The component knows two languages only (Arabic / everything else): zh, de and ru pages append the English line too. Carries the brand (owner_questions.brand).

later_rounds.rule: ui.ts keys and category labels that no built /ur/ page (and no round-1 attraction page) renders. They belong to the rounds that build their pages.

english_by_precedent.en: An independent initiative: a digital travel guide to Al-Ahsa Governorate, Saudi Arabia — not a government body and not affiliated with any official authority.
english_by_precedent.ar: مبادرة مستقلة: دليل سياحي رقمي عن محافظة الأحساء في السعودية — ليست جهة حكومية ولا تمثل أي هيئة رسمية.
english_by_precedent.renders: JSON-LD Organization.description on every page (search engines only)
english_by_precedent.note: zh, de and ru all carry the ENGLISH sentence here: the earlier lines never translated it.

already_in_urdu.rule: Rendered on the pages of the batch, and the code already carries their Urdu: approved text of an earlier batch, not reopened here.

not_in_this_batch.not_text: The .eyebrow letter-spacing, the OG card image, the header thresholds, the unlisted table and the build guards are engineering steps, not strings. The OG card (public/og-default-ur.png) is generated from home.hero.eyebrow, and the web-app manifest description from home.hero.lead: both are strings of this batch.

english_that_stays_on_the_three_pages_af.note: Measured on the trace build: Latin text on the four pages that no string of this batch replaces. It keeps counting against the 20% threshold of build check C22 until its own batches land.

content_of_untranslated_attractions.why: titles and summaries of attractions with no title_ur, on the index cards, the home featured cards, the "nearby" cards and the ItemList JSON-LD

trails_section.why: titles and taglines of suggested trails (src/data/trails.json): the trails have no Urdu version; the section heading itself (trails.partOf) is in the batch
